title: Padelford Riverboats
specs: Fleet of authentic sternwheelers and paddleboats Coast Guard-certified
Scenic views of Mississippi River, St. Paul riverfront, and Mississippi National Great River Park
Educational narration covering history, wildlife, and river ecology
Groups of 50 or more required for school field trips; smaller groups can be combined
No dress code; dress based on occasion
Vessels are multi-deck with raised thresholds; no rail lifts or elevators
Restrooms on Anson Northrup and Betsey Northrup have grab bars; Jonathan Padelford restrooms not wheelchair accessible
School field trips require minimum 50 students; smaller groups can be combined
Private charters accommodate 25 to 600 passengers depending on vessel
Wedding events accommodate up to 500 passengers

blurb: Guests take narrated sightseeing cruises, dining cruises, and themed cruises on authentic sternwheelers and paddleboats on the Mississippi River. The cruises offer views of the St. Paul riverfront and the Mississippi National Great River Park. Private charters are available for weddings, corporate events, school celebrations, and other private occasions.
